sources.title: 美國墾務局水工手冊與專論目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 美國墾務局設計標準官方入口
sources.scope: 官方章節目錄包括反濾、滲流、監測、地震及溢洪道；適用性仍需地方規範及專案評估。
sources.scopeEn: Official chapters include filters, seepage, monitoring, seismic design and spillways; applicability still requires local codes and project assessment.

sources.title: 土石壩儀器與監測設計標準
sources.scope: 已讀2014年章節與滲流、孔壓、變形及潛在失效模式監測架構；教學數值另行假設。
sources.scopeEn: Read the 2014 chapter framework for seepage, pore pressure, deformation and potential-failure-mode monitoring; numerical lessons are separately assumed.

sources.title: 土石壩反濾層設計標準
sources.scope: 2011年官方索引及搜尋摘錄核實反濾功能分類；大型PDF超擷取限制，未聲稱全文取回，算例非規範允收值。
sources.scopeEn: The 2011 official index and indexed passages verify filter-function classes; the large PDF exceeded retrieval limits, so full-text access is not claimed. Examples are not acceptance criteria.

sources.title: 土石壩靜力穩定分析標準
sources.scope: 2011年章節提供穩定與水位工況脈絡，並非本課合成邊坡的地層資料。
sources.scopeEn: The 2011 chapter supplies stability and reservoir-stage context, not ground data for the synthetic slopes.

sources.title: 美國墾務局土石壩百年技術回顧
sources.scope: 2002年原始機構回顧包括Fontenelle及Teton事件與工程發展；不把教學模型當事故重現。
sources.scopeEn: The 2002 institutional account includes Fontenelle and Teton events and engineering development; teaching models do not reconstruct those incidents.

sources.title: FEMA 滲流與內部沖蝕評估監測
sources.titleEn: FEMA seepage and internal-erosion evaluation and monitoring
sources.scope: 官方檢索核實滲流與內部沖蝕監測指引；課程用於證據與失效路徑比較，不自訂警戒門檻。
sources.scopeEn: Official retrieval identifies seepage and internal-erosion monitoring guidance; used for evidence and failure-path comparisons, not invented trigger thresholds.

sources.title: USGS 邊坡監測科學計畫
sources.scope: 官方說明持續觀測邊坡與觸發機制研究；研究站資料不是本課案例量測。
sources.scopeEn: Official overview describes sustained landslide observation and trigger research; station data are not measurements for these teaching cases.

sources.title: USGS 郭卜水庫邊坡水文控制研究
sources.scope: 原始研究記錄拉西瓦郭卜邊坡由庫水位轉為降雨相關的變形；僅比較監測解釋，不借用論文參數作設計。
sources.scopeEn: Original research documents changing level and rainfall associations at Guobu beside Laxiwa; used to compare monitoring interpretations, not as design parameters.

sources.title: USACE 溢洪道水力設計手冊
sources.scope: 官方索引核實EM1110-2-1603與1990年日期；直接頁面取回受限，不聲稱全文閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Official index verifies EM1110-2-1603 and its 1990 date; direct retrieval was restricted, and full-text review is not claimed.

sources.title: 胡佛壩業主工程與歷史入口
sources.titleEn: Hoover Dam owner engineering and history portal
sources.scope: 業主公開工程、歷史及水務資料入口；本課以水工系統作比較，不主張每種工法在此使用。
sources.scopeEn: Owner portal for engineering, history and water operations; a hydraulic-system comparison, not an assertion that every method is used there.

sources.title: 格倫峽谷壩業主資料
sources.scope: 業主資料確認壩、進水、壓力管與溢洪道的系統脈絡；不採公開庫容當本課合成模型的輸入。
sources.scopeEn: Owner information confirms dam, intake, penstock and spillway context; public storage figures are not inputs to synthetic lesson models.

sources.title: 階梯溢洪道水力設計指引
sources.titleEn: Guidelines for Hydraulic Design of Stepped Spillways
sources.scope: 已取回2015年原始指引，包含流態、階高、含氣、邊牆與氣蝕議題；本課數值並非其設計範例。
sources.scopeEn: Retrieved the 2015 original guide covering regimes, step geometry, aeration, walls and cavitation; lesson quantities are not its design examples.

sources.title: 方特內爾壩側槽水力模型報告
sources.titleEn: Fontenelle Dam spillway hydraulic model studies
sources.scope: 已取回1962年雙側槽、陡槽與消能池試驗報告，用於比較模型驗證流程，不移植其設計參數。
sources.scopeEn: Retrieved the 1962 double-side-channel, chute and basin study; used to compare validation methods without transplanting design parameters.

sources.title: 美國墾務局水工研究報告目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實1987年Upper Stillwater階梯溢洪道研究及1971年Yellowtail摻氣研究，僅作技術文件時間軸。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1987 Upper Stillwater stepped-spillway and 1971 Yellowtail aeration studies; used as publication chronology only.

sources.title: 蒙蒂塞洛壩與鐘口溢洪道業主資料
sources.titleEn: Monticello Dam and morning-glory spillway owner facts
sources.scope: 業主確認Monticello鐘口型溢洪道與1957年建壩；課程幾何水頭均另行假設，不以公開庫容作演算。
sources.scopeEn: Owner confirms the morning-glory spillway and 1957 dam construction; course geometry and heads are assumed, and public storage is not used in calculations.

sources.title: 溢洪道氣蝕與摻氣分析官方資料
sources.titleEn: Official spillway cavitation and aeration analysis resources
sources.scope: 已讀官方頁，確認EM42氣蝕專論與2021年平滑及階梯槽功能更新；未宣稱軟體結果能取代實體驗證。
sources.scopeEn: Read the official page confirming EM42 and the 2021 smooth/stepped-chute update; software results are not presented as substitutes for physical validation.

sources.title: 美國陸軍工兵團水工鋼構設計手冊
sources.titleEn: USACE design of hydraulic steel structures
sources.scope: 官方索引核實EM1110-2-2107及2022年出版日期；PDF直接取回受限，僅用可查證索引與主題，不聲稱讀過全文。
sources.scopeEn: Official index verifies EM1110-2-2107 and its 2022 publication; direct PDF access was restricted, so full-text review is not claimed.

sources.title: 弧形閘門正常運轉失效機制
sources.titleEn: Failure of radial gates under normal operating conditions
sources.scope: 官方原始風險章節核實弧形閘門配置與失效路徑，算例不是任何真實閘門設計荷載。
sources.scopeEn: Official original risk chapter identifies radial-gate arrangement and failure paths; example loads do not describe any real gate.

sources.title: 壩體收縮縫止水修復研究
sources.scope: 原始研究頁說明收縮縫運動造成既有金屬止水劣化及修復需求；不把研究成果當作現場保證。
sources.scopeEn: Original project page describes joint motion, metal-waterstop deterioration and repair needs; research is not a field-performance guarantee.

sources.title: 收縮縫滲漏修復合作研究
sources.scope: 官方研究頁核實深水修復材料遞送與接縫止水議題；課程施工算例為原創假設。
sources.scopeEn: Official research page verifies underwater repair delivery and joint-waterstop topics; construction examples are original assumptions.

sources.title: 美國陸軍工兵團壩安全技術入口
sources.scope: 官方入口列有垂直升降閘門EM1110-2-2701等技術資料，作為閘門查核脈絡。
sources.scopeEn: Official portal lists Vertical Lift Gates EM1110-2-2701 and related resources for gate-verification context.

sources.title: 西卡聚氯乙烯止水帶與接縫型式
sources.titleEn: Sika PVC waterstops and joint types
sources.scope: 已讀製造商頁面，核對活動與非活動接縫、型式與材料適用性；不宣稱供應任何本課工程，證券資料未查核。
sources.scopeEn: Read the manufacturer page for moving and nonmoving joints and material/profile applicability; no project supply role or verified security listing is claimed.

sources.title: 蘇黎世聯邦理工水工模型研究目錄
sources.titleEn: ETH Zurich hydraulic model research catalog
sources.scope: 已讀原始研究目錄，核實Solis繞庫排砂模型及Palagnedra磨耗研究脈絡；算例不是其量測值。
sources.scopeEn: Read the original research catalog confirming Solis bypass modeling and Palagnedra abrasion context; examples are not their measurements.

sources.title: 日本土木研究所水工與輸砂實驗室
sources.titleEn: PWRI hydraulics and sediment transport laboratory
sources.scope: 官方研究頁說明洪水繞庫排砂、含砂水與縮尺試驗限制；不把實驗比例當本課設計值。
sources.scopeEn: Official laboratory page describes flood sediment bypass, turbid flow and physical-model limits; laboratory scales are not course design inputs.

sources.title: 日本國土交通省美和壩繞庫排砂
sources.publisher: Ministry of Land Infrastructure Transport and Tourism
sources.scope: 官方原始頁核實美和繞庫隧道與試驗運轉歷程；僅用作排砂途徑比較，無工程參數移植。
sources.scopeEn: Official page verifies Miwa bypass and its trial-operation history; used for pathway comparison without transplanting parameters.

sources.title: 洛桑聯邦理工異重流排砂研究
sources.scope: 官方典藏索引核實2016年異重流排砂原始研究；全文直取回傳429，未宣稱全文閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Official repository index verifies the 2016 venting research; full-text retrieval returned429 and is not claimed.

sources.title: 異重流排砂操作時機原始研究
sources.scope: 官方典藏搜尋核實2018年時機與效率研究；直接PDF受限，僅據可見摘要及書目界定主題。
sources.scopeEn: Official repository search verifies the 2018 timing and efficiency study; direct PDF access was restricted, so only visible abstract and bibliographic scope are used.

sources.title: 魯德巴爾洛雷斯坦水庫排砂模型研究
sources.scope: 官方典藏摘要核實具名水庫的異重流排砂研究，非實際運轉成效保證；直取全文受限。
sources.scopeEn: Official repository abstract verifies the named reservoir venting investigation, not guaranteed operational performance; full-text access was restricted.

sources.title: 美國墾務局水庫泥砂經濟模型
sources.scope: 2023年RSEM技術報告第2.2節的Muddy水庫為虛構經濟模型算例；官方索引另列Muddy Creek抽泥與排砂示範，不視為已實作工程。模型不代替詳細水理、輸砂與經濟研究。
sources.scopeEn: Section 2.2 of the 2023 RSEM technical report describes Muddy Reservoir as a hypothetical economic-model example. The official index lists Muddy Creek dredging and sluicing demonstrations, not verified constructed projects. Detailed hydraulic, sediment and economic investigations remain necessary.

sources.title: 米爾賽特水庫抽泥提案公告
sources.scope: 官方申請公告描述吸泥與浮管輸送，僅為擬議方案，不聲稱施工完成或已有許可。
sources.scopeEn: Official application notice describes suction dredging and floating pipelines as proposed work; completion or permit approval is not asserted.

sources.title: 水庫泥砂管理與分析技術說明
sources.titleEn: Reservoir sediment management and analysis technical note
sources.scope: 官方2019年技術說明核實泥砂策略、疏浚、沖砂與環境整合分析主題；不將案例資料當教學設計輸入。
sources.scopeEn: Official 2019 technical note verifies integrated sediment strategy, dredging, flushing and environmental analysis; case data are not teaching design inputs.

sources.title: 埃及水利部阿斯旺高壩資料
sources.titleEn: Egypt water ministry Aswan High Dam information
sources.publisher: Egypt Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation
sources.scope: 官方搜尋摘要核實堆石壩型式、河床以上111m及1971年1月15日揭幕；直取頁面逾時，不採不同官方頁互有差異的長度。
sources.scopeEn: Official indexed text verifies rockfill type,111m above riverbed and inauguration on15January1971; direct retrieval timed out. Conflicting lengths across official pages are excluded.

sources.title: 巴基斯坦水電開發署塔貝拉壩
sources.scope: 已讀業主頁，核實印度河土石壩與河床以上143m；不將公開高度當教學運轉水頭，也不採變動的容量排名。
sources.scopeEn: Read the owner page verifying the Indus embankment dam and143m above riverbed; public height is not a teaching operating head and changing rankings are excluded.

sources.title: 世界銀行塔貝拉第四擴建資料
sources.titleEn: World Bank Tarbela fourth extension factsheet
sources.scope: 2020年原始計畫頁核實1976年壩完工、灌溉防洪發電用途及2012年第四擴建批准；不採內文相互不符的早期機組加總。
sources.scopeEn: The2020 primary project factsheet verifies1976 dam completion, irrigation/flood/power purposes and2012 fourth-extension approval; inconsistent early unit arithmetic is excluded.

sources.title: 塔貝拉壩計畫原始績效評估
sources.titleEn: Original Tarbela Dam project performance audit
sources.scope: 已檢索1986年原始評估與工程附表，包含深厚地基鋪蓋、低位出口與卡里巴水墊比較；僅作歷史工程脈絡，不移植尺寸。
sources.scopeEn: Retrieved indexed sections of the1986 primary audit covering foundation blankets, low outlets and a Kariba pool comparison; used for historical context without transplanting dimensions.

sources.title: 尚比西河管理局卡里巴修復融資公告
sources.titleEn: Zambezi River Authority rehabilitation financing announcement
sources.scope: 已讀2015年原始公告，核實1956至1959年建壩與修復融資；不以預定工期推論實際完工。
sources.scopeEn: Read the2015 announcement verifying construction in1956–1959 and rehabilitation financing; planned schedules are not treated as completion evidence.

sources.title: 卡里巴水墊整形業主說明
sources.scope: 已讀業主對沖坑、回向沖蝕、整形與圍堰施工的說明及1958年蓄水監測；舊文預定工期不當目前狀態。
sources.scopeEn: Read the owner account of scour, reshaping and cofferdam work, including monitoring since1958 impoundment; old schedule language is not a current-status assertion.

sources.title: 卡里巴溢洪閘門修復業主說明
sources.scope: 已讀六孔閘門、混凝土變形影響啟閉與備援隔水概念；頁內過時採購預計不作實際施工結論。
sources.scopeEn: Read the six-gate configuration, concrete-deformation operating concern and backup-isolation concept; outdated procurement forecasts are not treated as achieved work.

sources.title: 伏爾塔河管理局阿科松博電廠
sources.titleEn: Volta River Authority Akosombo hydro plant
sources.scope: 已讀業主頁核實堆石壩、1961至1965年建設與頁列1020MW；高度111/141m及壩頂長640/660m互有矛盾，明確排除。
sources.scopeEn: Read owner confirmation of rockfill type,1961–1965 construction and listed1020MW; conflicting111/141m heights and640/660m crest lengths are explicitly excluded.

sources.title: 大迪克桑斯壩業主工程資料
sources.titleEn: Grande Dixence Dam owner engineering information
sources.scope: 已讀業主資料核實重力壩285m、1951至1961年建設及1961年起啟用；不把壩高當水電系統淨落差。
sources.scopeEn: Read owner confirmation of the285m gravity dam,1951–1961 construction and commissioning from1961; dam height is not scheme net head.

sources.title: 大迪克桑斯與克勒松系統工程史
sources.titleEn: Grande Dixence and Cleuson scheme history
sources.scope: 已讀業主歷史頁，核實原Dixence、Cleuson及Grande Dixence不同階段，避免把不同壩或擴建年代混為一談。
sources.scopeEn: Read the owner history distinguishing original Dixence, Cleuson and Grande Dixence phases rather than conflating dams or later expansions.

scope: Original hypothetical calculations; source-supported principles and publication years; comparisons are not design reconstructions; security listings unverified and null.
